questions.text: What is your hometown famous for?

cueCard.topic: Describe a piece of technology that you use often.
cueCard.explain: and explain why it is important to you.

questions.text: Describe a piece of technology that you use often.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a piece of technology that you use often. You should say: what it is; when you got it; how often you use it; and explain why it is important to you.

questions.text: Do you think you will still use it in five years' time?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you think you will still use it in five years' time?

questions.text: How has technology changed the way families spend time together?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a piece of technology you use often, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all technology at home. How has technology changed the way families spend time together?

questions.text: Do older people find it harder to use new technology? Why?
questions.say: Do older people find it harder to use new technology? Why?

questions.text: Is there any technology that you think people rely on too much?
questions.say: Is there any technology that you think people rely on too much?

questions.text: Which jobs do you think will be done by machines in the future?
questions.say: Now let's talk about technology and work. Which jobs do you think will be done by machines in the future?

questions.text: Has technology made people's working lives easier or harder?
questions.say: Has technology made people's working lives easier or harder?

questions.text: Should governments control the development of new technology?
